identification: Pearl Vorg 101 (panel reads VORG 101, not Borg): Japanese-made Pearl solid-state 2-channel combo with spring reverb, probably 2x12 on castors. Vorg was a Pearl brand name; sources place Vorg/Pearl amps in the 1970s to early 1980s. Search found sources calling the Vorg 101 solid state, not valve. Worn tolex, grubby grille.
